cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied your smile for our happy concert memory. Now tell me you understand what your empty seat felt like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I smiled because you played the encore beautifully. My train was cancelled; I wanted to be there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Watch my face before the encore. Can you see what waiting for you was doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw you look at the door just before you started. You thought I might still come.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Say you understand that I was still saving part of the evening for you, even while I was playing.

reason: State A false happy-memory interpretation and replace encore-smile label with a concrete request to inspect visible waiting.
